question: Why do Hermitian eigenvectors form a complete orthonormal basis, and how does this construct a rectangular SVD?
entry: 2.4 Hermitian real forms, positivity and unitary norms; provide compactness/maximum and orthonormal-completion bridges locally.
exit: Prove Hermitian diagonalization without circular eigenbasis assumptions; construct full rectangular SVD including zero singular values and kernel; validate reconstruction independently of vector phases.

Exact kernels/zero singular values distinguished from numerical threshold decisions
